Cutera excel HR laser hair removal in New Cairo

Explore laser hair removal with Cutera excel HR at {{brand}} in Cairo. Watch our device in use and learn how skin, hair and treatment area guide the session plan.

Available at {{brand}}

Two wavelengths.
Chosen for your treatment.

Our Cutera excel HR device has 755 nm and 1064 nm wavelength options. We assess your skin, hair and treatment area before choosing the settings.

Watch the clips below for a look at our Cutera device and its treatment controls.

755 nm1064 nmPersonalised laser care
Ask about Cutera
01 / Hair

Hair reduction

Ask about laser hair reduction for the face or body. We will discuss the area, session spacing and likely number of visits after assessing your skin and hair.

02 / Skin

Skin revitalisation

Talk to our team about your skin concern. We can explain which treatments are available with this device and whether one suits your needs.

03 / Your plan

Assessment comes first

Tell us about recent sun exposure, medicines and previous treatments. This helps us advise you on preparation, timing and aftercare.

Before your visit

Cutera, explained.

Does {{brand}} have a Cutera device?

Yes. We have a Cutera excel HR device at {{brand}} in Cairo. Contact us before visiting to confirm the branch and available appointments.

Which Cutera device is featured here?

This is Cutera excel HR, with 755 nm and 1064 nm wavelength options. Both clips were filmed at {{brand}}.

How many Cutera sessions will I need?

It depends on your skin, hair, treatment area and goals. We will suggest a schedule after your assessment and review how you respond.

How do I book a Cutera consultation?

Message our team with the treatment or concern you would like to discuss. We will confirm the branch and help you arrange a consultation.

How much does Cutera laser hair removal cost?

Cost depends on the area and the session plan agreed after assessment. Ask the branch on WhatsApp for a quote and discuss your plan before booking.

Explore the technology

Read Cutera's overview of skin revitalisation and resurfacing. Ask our team which of these treatments are available with the device at our clinic.
